name: MBM Contracting
text: MENU Construction Management Home Services Construction Management Collaboration and Integration The CM delivery method allows us to collaborate with the owner and the design team from the earliest stages of a project to expedite the delivery process. As the CM, MBM acts as the project liaison to fully integrate the project team. Using this method can help reduce overall project costs by means of competitive bidding, contract negotiation, value engineering, and schedule efficiency. Other CM services include master scheduling, coordination of material/equipment purchasing, on-site management, subcontractor supervision, and enhanced quality control. Our CM process includes: Initial design document review in comparison to budgetary goals Review documents for constructability and coordination issues Ongoing scope refinement while maintaining schedule and budget Cost estimating during schematic design, design development, and GMP submission Value engineering to achieve desired function at lowest overall cost Development of a site logistics plan and a master schedule Prequalification of subcontractors, prepare bid packages, and analyze bids Identify long-lead items Trusted by Top Companies "MBM has always been responsive to our needs.
